svg.title: BT node types
svg.desc: A behavior tree drawn the py_trees way, root on the left and each node's children in the next column to its right. The root handle_cell is an orange box with tag 1. Its three children, top to bottom: wait_for_reading, a gold parallelogram with tag 3, whose children are the gray ellipses tester_ok and wait_for_voltage; retry_pick, a white ellipse with tag 4, with the gray ellipse pick_from_tester to its right; and place_or_recycle, a cyan octagon with tag 2. The octagon's children are the orange box place_if_good, whose children are the gray ellipses voltage_in_range and place_in_slot, and the gray ellipse recycle_cell, which carries tag 5.
